comments.author: @howardnd9043
comments.text: Very, very good report. But as a native North Dakotan that has traveled the entire state many times over for work and pleasure, I did see a few small mistakes.  But, a glaring one is about Pyramid Hill.  Most of the footage shows the Cold War era radar site that is located near Nekoma, which is about 150 miles from Fort Ransom, and about 50 miles from MN and 25 from Canada. Both are worth a visit, though. Also, THANK  YOU for pronouncing Sakakawea correctly, with many adding a "g" into her name. My favorite place in our state is the Killdeer Mountains area. I've taken some stunning photos there.  Thanks for a meaningful story, not one with a bunch of "made up" garbage.  We are blessed to live here.
